summary: Add an optional transport-free sidebar widget with original TUI golden parity

schema.detail: No database or wire schema change.

compatibility.detail: The ratatui feature adds a borrowed-row sidebar renderer and semantic hit regions; the TUI remains on its original renderer and default features remain empty. A self dev-dependency enables ratatui in ordinary workspace tests so hosted CI exercises the painter and golden parity test.

recovery.detail: The widget is unwired; reverting it requires no persisted-state migration.
